caseNameFull: Smith v. Board of Education, Independent School District No. 1, Tulsa County, Oklahoma

opinions.text:
C. A. 10th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Keyes v. School District No. 1, ante, p. 189.

Mr. Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
